rulings.item: The CI train (NIJI_TRAIN) neither reads nor writes the product or trace cache, as for the layout verdict cache
rulings.recommendation: keep it off under the train (the train is the trust anchor); revisit once local use has shown no stale set

informational: ~/bin/gate resets the environment (its own PATH), so gate builds and builds outside the gate never share a set (PATH is a key input); a second gate on the same tree hits
The direct gate's tests write spec/tools/__pycache__/*.pyc into the tree; the keys now skip __pycache__ (commit ae4f4bd28)

Library mutants: per-product keys would skip almost nothing, because nearly every product takes libc.a, libc.so.6 or the niji-boundary build as input (challenge #8851, accepted). The library-mutant 'before' (cache off) run was not made, to leave time for the final gate; the 'after' run (604.8 s) does all the work an uncached build does, plus the about 1.8 s key
